2607.17481.title: Panache: One-Pass Motif Discovery at Every Window Length
2607.17481.paper_summary: Motif discovery, the search for recurring patterns within a time series, is a core primitive of exploratory data analysis. A pattern, however, is defined by its duration, which analysts rarely know in advance. To resolve this unknown duration, an interval of window lengths is defined, and the accepted method is to try every length in that interval. Existing pan matrix profile (PMP) methods compute one z-normalized matrix profile per length, so $L$ lengths cost $L$ quadratic self-joins over the same series. We introduce Panache, to our knowledge the first one-pass streaming algorithm for z-normalized PMP motif discovery. It replaces the repeated self-joins with a single scan whose runtime is near-linear in the series length. The key observation is that mean-centering a subsequence changes only its DC Fourier coefficient, so the non-DC spectrum of every z-normalized subsequence can be maintained online by sliding-DFT recurrences and running statistics. This spectral state is the key under which similar subsequences collide in an occupancy-controlled hash directory and, through Parseval's theorem, yields a lower bound that rejects most colliding pairs before any exact computation. Panache computes every data-dependent parameter itself, leaving only a resource budget to tune. At the default budget, it recovers all top-20 pan-motifs against exact fixed-exclusion ground truth on 17 UCR configurations, and is faster than every CPU and GPU baseline benchmarked in this paper. On Wafer at five million samples over 51 lengths, Panache completes one pass in 2.9 minutes and emits the exact motifs in 6.0 minutes, against 7.95 hours for the fastest exact CPU baseline and 38.3 minutes for SCAMP on an H100 GPU.
2607.17481.paper_summary_zh: 發現模式，即在時間序列中尋找重複出現的模式，是探索性數據分析的核心原始操作。然後，模式的定義取決於其持續時間，而分析師通常無法提前知道這一點。為了解決這個未知的持續時間，定義了一個窗口長度的區間，接受的方法是在該區間內嘗試每個長度。現有的全矩陣剖面（PMP）方法對每個長度計算一個z標準化的矩陣剖面，因此$L$個長度的成本是對同一序列進行$L$次二次自連接。我們介紹了Panache，據我們所知，這是第一個一次性流式算法，用於z標準化的PMP模式發現。它用一次掃描替代了重複的自連接，其運行時間接近於序列長度的線性。關鍵觀察是，對子序列進行均值中心化僅改變其DC傅里葉係數，因此每個z標準化子序列的非DC頻譜可以通過滑動DFT重複和運行統計在線維護。這一頻譜狀態是相似子序列在佔用控制的哈希目錄中碰撞的關鍵，並且通過Parseval定理，提供了一個下界，能在任何精確計算之前拒絕大多數碰撞對。Panache自己計算每個數據依賴的參數，只留下資源預算進行調整。在默認預算下，它在17個UCR配置上恢復所有前20個全模式，並且比本文中基準的每個CPU和GPU基準都要快。在Wafer上，對於五百萬個樣本和51個長度，Panache在2.9分鐘內完成一次掃描，並在6.0分鐘內發出精確的模式，而最快的精確CPU基準需要7.95小時，SCAMP在H100 GPU上則需要38.3分鐘。
